row.notes: (mz) Clears per-zone state (+0x88..+0x90 stride 0x10), then for each participant ([+0x48]+0x88..+0x90) uses its zone entry this+0x10b8+idx*8 to update the zones it occupies (92 lines). Called from Sess_MarshalZone_CheckFlags. Hypothesis. Decoded (engine-re track RE round B 2026-11-17, static): clears zone+0x40 (car bit set) and +0xa8; for each car with a zone entry (this+0x10b8 + car*8) computes the lap fraction (clamp 0..1) and puts the car into the FIRST zone in list order whose item Start <= f <= End (wrapped zone End < Start: f >= Start or f <= End), setting zone+0x50 flag, bit car in zone+0x40.., and +0xa8 when the car's [..]+0x160 is set. Overlapping zones: only the first in list order ever gets the car, later overlapping zones stay empty.
